title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller — AI Agency (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
THE COMPANY

We are an AI-driven marketing agency that helps established businesses across the United States automate and modernize how they handle inbound leads and calls — primarily through AI receptionist/voice agent systems, with premium website builds as a secondary offer. Our clients are business owners in industries like roofing, HVAC, construction, med spas, chiropractic, and other high-ticket service businesses. These are not startups — they are existing businesses that are already making money and ready to invest in systems that capture more of the revenue they're currently leaving on the table.

We are growing fast and looking for a driven, organized, and persistent appointment setter to join our team remotely.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your primary job is to cold call and set appointments for our sales team with leads we provide for you. Once an appointment is made, you must also notify our sales team with all relevant information to the appointment.



Cold Calling:



Make outbound calls to business owners during US business hours using our dialer

Follow a proven script — we will provide it

Qualify leads — are they an established business with revenue? Are they missing calls or losing leads to voi
? Do they have a weak website or no website? Are they open to improving how they handle inbound calls and leads?

Handle objections confidently and professionally

Book qualified appointments on our sales rep's calendar using a scheduling tool



Follow-Up:



Follow up with leads who did not answer on the first attempt — minimum 3 attempts per lead before marking as no contact

Send follow-up texts or
s to warm leads after initial contact

Re-engage old leads who were interested but did not book

Keep your lead tracker updated in real time — every call logged, every outcome noted



Additional Responsibilities:



Research competitor websites and phone/booking setups for industries you are calling so you can speak intelligently about what an AI receptionist or better website would do for them

Flag any leads who seem especially hot to the sales team immediately

Suggest new industries or niches to target based on what you are seeing in the market

Help build and refine the script over time based on what objections come up most



WHO THIS IS FOR

This person is the right fit if they:



Have done cold calling or outbound sales before and are not afraid of rejection

Are comfortable working inside a dialer and hitting daily call targets

Are extremely organized — you live in your spreadsheet and your calendar

Communicate clearly and professionally in English — written and spoken

Are self-motivated — you do not need someone to tell you to make calls

Are comfortable finding their own leads from scratch every day

Have reliable internet and a quiet place to work

Are available during US business hours — at minimum 9am to 5pm in at least one US time zone

Are motivated by results, not clocked hours — this is a fully commission-based role



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

Do not apply if:



You have never made cold calls before and are not willing to learn fast

You need someone to hand you a list every day

You are looking for a passive or low-effort role, or want guaranteed hourly pay

You give up after one or two rejections

Your English is not strong enough to have a confident business conversation



COMPENSATION

This is a COMMISSION-ONLY role — there is no base or hourly pay.



$10 per qualified appointment that shows up to the call, starting rate

Up to $200 per closed deal, starting rate

Both rates scale up based on performance — consistent high performers earn more per appointment and per close over time

This role has room to grow — the right person can move from setter to closer, with commission on deals they close directly

A top caller can make upwards of 100$ in pure commission



WHAT A GREAT DAY LOOKS LIKE



250–300 dialer calls made daily

5–10 qualified appointments booked daily

Every call logged with outcome and notes

Follow-ups sent to all warm leads from the week prior

Lead tracker fully up to date by end of Friday



Note on performance: call volume is the activity standard, not the success metric. You're evaluated on appointments shown and deals closed — not on dials made. Someone hitting 300 calls with no shows is not outperforming someone hitting 250 calls and booking consistently.

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered you must do the following exactly — applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



Start your application with the subject line or first line: "MALIBU READY"

Write 3–5 sentences about your cold calling experience — be specific, not general

Tell us what industry you would target first and why

Tell us what you would say in the first 10 seconds of a cold call to a roofing company owner

Include your resume or work history



Applications that do not start with "MALIBU READY" will be automatically filtered out. This is intentional. It tells us you read carefully and follow instructions — two things this job requires every single day.

ADDITIONAL TASKS THIS SAME PERSON CAN OWN

Here's everything else you can stack onto this role that a good appointment setter can handle without it becoming a different job:



CRM data entry — logging all calls, outcomes, and follow-ups into a shared sheet or CRM tool

Prospect research — building lead lists for new industries or cities before calling begins

 outreach — sending cold
s to businesses that didn't answer the phone, following a template

Social media lead gen — finding business owners through
 groups, Instagram, or LinkedIn who might be a fit

Script testing — trying different openers and reporting back what gets the best response rate

Appointment confirmation — texting or
ing booked leads 24 hours before their appointment to reduce no-shows

No-show re-engagement — calling back people who missed their appointment to reschedule

Competitor research — identifying businesses in each niche with bad websites or no call-handling system and flagging them as priority targets

Weekly reporting — sending a simple end-of-week report: calls made, appointments booked, no contacts, follow-ups pending

title: Part-Time Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - Web Design Agency (US/UK/AU)
description:
Agentica is a Bulgaria-based digital agency. We build websites and manage online presence for small businesses. We are looking for a part-time cold caller to book appointments for us.



Start small, prove it works, grow into a full-time seat.



How this works?

- We start with a paid 2-week trial

- You choose 2 to 4 hours per day, Monday to Friday

- We track your dials, connects, and appointments booked

- If the numbers are good, we move you to more hours and eventually full time



We are being upfront: this is a small commitment at first because we want to test the process together, not because we are unserious. The trial is paid at full rate from day one. We are building this desk to run permanently, and the first person in is the person who leads it later.



What you'll do?

- Call small businesses from a list we provide - you never build lists, you only call

- Around 20–35 dials per hour

- Get past the small talk, qualify the owner, book a 15-minute appointment

- Log outcomes in our CRM

- Short written end-of-shift summary



Markets and hours

We sell into the UK, the US, and Australia, and we rotate between them depending on which campaign is running. You will not work all three at once. Each campaign block runs for a stretch of days or weeks, and we agree your hours before it starts:

- UK campaigns: afternoon/evening Manila time

- Australia campaigns: morning Manila time

- US campaigns: late night Manila time



Because of this, you need to be genuinely flexible about which part of the day you work. If you can only work mornings, this role is not for you. If you like variety and can adapt, this suits you well.



The offer you'll be pitching?

Most of the businesses we call have no website at all, or one that hasn't been updated in years. We build the site with small upfront cost and they pay a low monthly fee covering hosting, maintenance, updates, and their Google presence. No large cheque to sign means a far easier conversation than most cold calling jobs you have had.



What we need from you?

- Clear, confident, neutral English - Western business owners must be at ease on the phone with you

- Previous outbound calling, BPO, or appointment setting experience

- Stable internet (10 Mbps+), working headset, quiet workspace

- Flexibility on hours across time zones

- Resilience. You will be hung up on constantly. The people who win here treat it as a numbers game and keep dialing.



Compensation

- $3-5 USD per hour, paid weekly via Wise during the trial

- $25 USD per qualified appointment that shows up - uncapped

- Higher hourly rate for US late-night campaigns

- Hours and base rate both increase once you prove the numbers

- Full-time seat available to whoever performs



HOW TO APPLY - we ignore applications that skip this

1. Record a voice clip of yourself, maximum 60 seconds:

"You are calling a small plumbing business. The owner picks up and sounds busy. Open the call and try to get him to agree to a 15-minute chat about his online presence. Improvise - do not read a script."

2. Upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, or Vocaroo and put the link at the very top of your application. Begin your application with the word KETTLE so we know you read this fully.

3.Also tell us in one line: which time zone blocks can you realistically commit to?



Applications without a voice clip will not be reviewed.

title: Affiliate Marketing & Link Promotion Specialist
description:
Absolutely—AI should be clearly allowed for research, content creation, captions, graphics, planning, and strategy, as long as the work remains accurate and produces genuine results.



Affiliate Marketing & Link Promotion Specialist



We are looking for a creative, independent, and results-driven Affiliate Marketing Specialist to promote affiliate links and generate genuine clicks, sign-ups, and sales.



You will have the freedom to choose how and where you distribute the links. You may use social media pages,
 groups, Pinterest, TikTok, blogs, online communities,
 marketing, or other approved marketing methods. You are not restricted to one specific platform or posting strategy.



Your Main Goal



Generate high-quality traffic that converts—not simply random clicks.



Your performance will be based on:



* Affiliate-link clicks

* Click-through rates

* Sign-ups, sales, or other conversions

* Growth in traffic and engagement

* Consistency and overall results



Responsibilities



* Develop and test different affiliate-marketing strategies

* Promote provided affiliate links to relevant audiences

* Create or repurpose promotional content

* Research trending products, topics, keywords, and audience interests

* Track which links, posts, and platforms produce the best results

* Adjust your strategy based on performance

* Provide regular updates showing clicks, conversions, and completed work



AI Tools Are Allowed



You are welcome to use AI tools to help you work more efficiently and produce better results.



AI may be used for:



* Writing captions, posts, scripts, titles, and product descriptions

* Brainstorming content ideas and marketing strategies

* Researching keywords, trends, products, and target audiences

* Creating graphics, videos, content calendars, and promotional materials

* Repurposing one piece of content for multiple platforms

* Organizing, analyzing, and improving marketing performance



AI-generated content must still be reviewed before posting. All information must be accurate, natural, relevant to the audience, and consistent with the brand.



Simply copying and pasting low-quality AI content, publishing misleading information, or creating excessive spam will not be accepted.



Creative Freedom

title: Social Media, Paid Ads & Direct Booking Specialist – Instagram, Facebook & TikTok
description:
We are looking for an experienced, creative and proactive Social Media, Paid Advertising & Direct Booking Specialist to manage and grow the online presence of our UK-based short-term accommodation and property management company, SascoUK.



We manage a large and growing portfolio of serviced accommodation, holiday lets, apartments and houses across Blackpool, Lytham St Annes and surrounding areas.



Our main goal is to significantly improve our social media presence across Instagram,
 and 
, build a recognisable brand and, most importantly, increase direct bookings through our own website.



We are not looking for someone who simply schedules a few posts each week.



We want someone who understands social media strategy, content creation, short-form video, organic growth, paid advertising and how to turn social media traffic into paying guests and direct bookings.



Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Managing our Instagram,
 and 
 accounts

Creating engaging Reels, TikToks, Stories, posts and other social content

Editing short-form videos using property footage and content supplied by our team

Creating attractive graphics and branded content

Planning and scheduling content consistently

Showcasing our properties in a way that makes people want to book

Promoting special offers, last-minute availability and seasonal campaigns

Creating content around local events, attractions and reasons to visit Blackpool and Lytham St Annes

Developing campaigns specifically designed to encourage guests to book directly through our website

Growing our social media following organically and attracting the right audience

Identifying trends, sounds and content opportunities relevant to our business

Repurposing content effectively across Instagram,
 and 

Monitoring performance, reach, engagement, website traffic and conversions

Providing ideas and recommendations rather than simply waiting to be told what to post

Reviewing competitor and hospitality social media accounts to identify opportunities for our brand

Paid Advertising & Event Campaigns



A key part of this role will be creating and managing targeted paid advertising campaigns to generate direct bookings.



Blackpool and Lytham St Annes have a busy calendar of events throughout the year, creating major opportunities to target visitors who need accommodation.



We want someone who can proactively identify these opportunities and create targeted advertising campaigns around them.



This could include:



Major concerts and music events

Lytham Festival

Blackpool Illuminations

Blackpool Air Show

Dance competitions

Sporting events and tournaments

Golf events

Conferences and exhibitions

School holidays

Bank holiday weekends

Christmas and New Year

Seasonal events

Other major events that attract visitors to the area



You will be expected to plan campaigns in advance of key events, identify the right audiences and locations to target, create engaging adverts and direct potential guests towards our website to book.



Experience with Meta Ads Manager,
 Ads, Instagram Ads and TikTok Ads would be highly valuable.



You should understand how to:



Build targeted audiences for specific events and visitor types

Create effective ad creatives and copy

Test different audiences, creatives and campaigns

Retarget people who have previously visited or engaged with our website/social media where possible

Monitor advertising spend and performance

Track clicks, enquiries and conversions

Optimise campaigns based on results

Understand metrics such as cost per click, cost per acquisition, ROAS and conversion rate

Recommend where our advertising budget should be spent to achieve the best return



We do not simply want to “boost posts”.



We want strategic, targeted advertising campaigns designed to generate measurable direct bookings and revenue.



Our Main Goal – More Direct Bookings



A major part of this role is helping us reduce our reliance on third-party booking platforms by encouraging more guests to discover our properties through social media and book directly through our own website.



We want someone who can think beyond likes and followers.



Our goal is:



Great Content ? Increased Reach ? Engaged Audience ? Website Visits ? Direct Bookings ? Repeat Guests



You should always be thinking about how our social media activity can ultimately contribute to increased bookings and revenue.



What We Are Looking For



We would particularly value previous experience working with:



Hospitality

Hotels

Serviced accommodation

Airbnb/holiday rentals

Travel and tourism

Property businesses



Experience in these industries is preferred but not essential if you can demonstrate excellent results in a similar business.



You should have:



Strong experience with Instagram,
 and 

Experience creating and managing paid social media advertising campaigns

Excellent short-form video/Reels/TikTok editing skills

A good eye for branding, design and visual presentation

Experience using tools such as Canva and CapCut or similar

Strong written English

An understanding of social media algorithms and current trends

An understanding of calls-to-action and conversion-focused content

The ability to analyse results and adjust strategies accordingly

Excellent organisation and consistency

The confidence to bring your own ideas and opportunities to the business



We don't want our social media to feel overly corporate or like every post is an advertisement.



We want a mixture of high-quality property content, engaging videos, personality, local/travel content, trends, behind-the-scenes content, useful information and promotional content that builds a genuine audience around the SascoUK brand.



Examples of Your Previous Work Are Essential



When applying, please send us:



A short introduction about yourself and your social media and digital marketing experience.

Links to Instagram,
 and/or TikTok accounts you have personally managed.

Examples of Reels, TikToks, graphics or campaigns you have personally created.

Examples of paid advertising campaigns you have managed, including results where possible.

Examples of results you have achieved, such as increased followers, reach, engagement, website traffic, leads, sales, bookings or return on advertising spend.

Please explain exactly what you were responsible for on the accounts you show us. For example, did you create the strategy, edit the videos, write the captions, create the graphics, run the ads and manage the account?

Tell us briefly what you would do in your first 30 days working with SascoUK to improve our social media and increase direct bookings.

Give us an example of how you would use social media and paid advertising to target visitors attending a major event in Blackpool or Lytham St Annes and encourage them to book accommodation directly with us.

Tell us which software and tools you currently use for content creation, editing, scheduling, paid advertising and analytics.



Please do not apply without examples of previous work.



We will be reviewing portfolios carefully because it is very important that your content style, creativity and quality fit with our brand.



What Success Looks Like



We want to see measurable improvements over time, including:



Increased social media reach and engagement

Consistent growth across Instagram,
 and 

Higher-quality and more engaging content

Increased traffic from social media to our website

More enquiries generated through social media

Increased direct bookings

Successful paid advertising campaigns with measurable returns

Growth of our repeat and direct-booking customer base

A stronger and more recognisable SascoUK brand online



We are looking for someone who would like to become a long-term part of our team and take genuine ownership of our social media and digital marketing growth.



We want someone proactive who will identify opportunities themselves – whether that is an upcoming event we should advertise around, a new social media trend we should take advantage of, or a campaign that could help fill available dates.



If you are creative, commercially minded and understand how to turn great social media and targeted advertising into real bookings and revenue, we would love to hear from you.



To show that you have read the full job description, please start your application with the words “DIRECT BOOKINGS” and include links to your best 3 examples of social media or paid advertising work.

The role will include executive support, customer communication, travel coordination, diary management, administration, social media and a broad range of unexpected tasks and projects.



You may find yourself arranging a business meeting one 
nt, coordinating personal travel the next, speaking with a customer, researching a new idea or helping improve how the business operates.

The volume of work may be relatively light and will vary throughout the day.

* Your skills and experience

* Your availability across Australian business hours

* The expected volume of work

* The responsibilities you are capable of managing

* Whether the position is structured as part-time or full-time

* Helping separate urgent priorities from tasks that can be handled later

* Anticipating what may be required before being asked

* Protecting the Founder’s time by reducing unnecessary interruptions and administrative work



You will have access to business and personal information, so discretion, maturity and confidentiality are essential.



Broader Responsibilities



Your responsibilities may also include:



* Answering incoming calls and handling enquiries professionally

* Communicating with customers and internal and external stakeholders

* Monitoring
s, messages and incoming requests

* Recording accurate messages and ensuring follow-up occurs

* Assisting with general administration and record keeping

* Supporting social media and basic content creation

* Entering, reviewing and maintaining information

* Learning new systems and business processes

* Researching unfamiliar topics

* Assisting with process improvements

* Completing unexpected or ad hoc tasks as they arise



No two days will necessarily look the same. We enjoy finding better ways to do things and are looking for someone who is curious, resourceful and comfortable learning as they go.



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a great fit if you have:



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills

* A warm, confident and professional telephone manner

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Excellent organisation and diary-management skills

* The ability to learn quickly and retain new information

* The ability to manage both business and personal tasks discreetly

* Good judgment when handling confidential or sensitive matters

* The flexibility to move between very different types of tasks

* Initiative and the confidence to solve problems independently

* The ability to anticipate what needs to happen next

* A positive attitude and good sense of humour

* Reliable internet, telephone and computer equipment

* Backup arrangements for power, internet or equipment disruptions



You do not need previous experience in our industry. We are more interested in your reliability, intelligence, communication skills, attention to detail and willingness to learn.



Artificial Intelligence and Productivity

* Complete work more efficiently

* Improve written communication

* Organise or summarise information

* Plan travel or manage schedules

* Learn a new task or system

* Automate repetitive work

* Improve accuracy or customer service

* Generate ideas for social media or business activities



We also expect applicants to understand that AI must be used responsibly.



Confidential, personal, financial or commercially sensitive information must not be entered into unapproved AI tools. AI should improve productivity without compromising privacy, security, accuracy or professional judgment.



Please explain both how you use AI and how you ensure sensitive information remains protected.



Flexibility, Salary and Career Potential



This position may be structured preferably as part-time or full-time for the right applicant.

description:
About Industry Core



Industry Core is a European industrial construction and project-support company with a strong operational base in the Netherlands. We provide skilled workforce and turnkey support for industrial, commercial and data-centre projects across Europe.



Our work includes HVAC and ventilation, piping and mechanical installation, electrical and automation, steel fabrication and welding, insulation and scaffolding, petrochemical maintenance, shutdown support and data-centre construction.



The Role



We are looking for a proactive B2B Sales Personal Assistant to support our sales and business-development activities. This is a hands-on outbound role for someone who is confident speaking with companies, finding decision-makers, starting conversations and following opportunities until a meeting or next step is secured.



The position starts at approximately 4 hours per day, Monday to Friday, during Netherlands business hours (CET/CEST). Depending on performance and ability, the role can grow to 6–8 hours per day.



Key Responsibilities



• Research potential B2B clients, contractors, EPC companies, project owners and decision-makers across Europe.

• Make outbound cold calls and introduce Industry Core’s construction services, project support and skilled workforce.

• Qualify leads, identify current or upcoming projects and schedule meetings for management.

• Conduct follow-up calls and
s and maintain professional communication with prospects.

• Build and update lead lists using LinkedIn, company websites and other business sources.

• Keep accurate CRM or spreadsheet records of calls, contacts, outcomes and next actions.

• Prepare simple sales summaries, client research, meeting notes and follow-up materials.

• Assist management with other sales-related and administrative tasks.

• Learn our technical services well enough to explain them clearly to potential clients.



Required Qualifications



• Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory.

• Proven B2B sales, cold-calling, appointment-setting or lead-generation experience is strongly preferred.

• Confident telephone communication and the ability to speak professionally with managers, procurement teams and technical decision-makers.

• Strong computer skills, including
, online research, spreadsheets, CRM tools and LinkedIn.

• Organised, reliable, self-motivated and persistent, with a genuine willingness to work and learn.

• Able to work independently, follow up consistently and report results clearly.

• Available during Netherlands business hours.



Strong Advantages



• German, French or Dutch language skills.

• Technical knowledge or work experience in HVAC/ventilation, piping, mechanical construction, electrical systems, automation, welding, steel construction, insulation, petrochemical plants or data centres.

• Previous sales experience in construction, engineering, industrial services, staffing or project support.



What Success Looks Like



You consistently find relevant companies and decision-makers, make high-quality outbound calls, create qualified opportunities, book meetings and maintain disciplined follow-up. We value initiative, honest reporting and measurable results.



How to Apply



Please include:

1. A short summary of your B2B sales and cold-calling experience.

2. The industries and countries you have worked with.

3. The languages you speak and your proficiency level.

4. Your availability during Netherlands business hours.

5. An example of a measurable sales or appointment-setting result you achieved.

Answer 80 to 100 customer
s a day inside Commslayer, our helpdesk. This is the core of the role.

 and Instagram comments and messages, also inside Commslayer.

 posts.

Fast and accurate. A queue of 80 to 100
s a day does not scare you.

Compensation



$400 per month to start

Performance bonuses for agents who consistently hit their metrics



What you get



100% remote, full time (48 hrs/week)

A long term role with a growing multi brand portfolio

A team that rewards reliability and results, and where loyalty pays

Fill out our short Google Form here:

title: Remote Sales Representative / Client Coordinator (Fluent in English) - (US Hours) (MALE only)
description:
We are hiring 3 Client Advisors / Crisis Response Coordinators to join our remote team. We are currently prioritizing candidates for Shift B. All shift schedules are based on Manila Time / Philippine Time (PHT).



As part of your application, please send a 60-second English voice recording introducing yourself, explaining why you are a strong fit for this role, and briefly summarizing your phone-based sales, client support, or customer service experience.



* Important Requirement: This is a full-time, dedicated role. We are looking for candidates who can fully commit to this position during the assigned shift.



This role is not suitable as a second job, side job, or additional freelance role. Because response time, reliability, and emotional availability are critical in this position, candidates must not be working another job that conflicts with their schedule, focus, or performance.



* About the Role: This role includes a sales component, but it is not an aggressive sales role. You will not be pushing a product to random leads.



Your job is to respond quickly to inbound inquiries, calm the client when needed, understand the urgency of the case, explain how the service works, recommend the right service package, and guide the client through agreement, payment, onboarding, and handoff to our operations team.



We are looking for candidates with a mature, steady, and confident phone presence. The right person should sound calm under pressure, communicate clearly with US-based clients, and handle sensitive conversations professionally.



* What You’ll Do:

- Respond to inbound leads through phone, SMS, WhatsApp,
, and messaging platforms within minutes.

- Conduct first consultations by listening to the client’s situation, assessing urgency, and recommending the most suitable service package.

- Explain the services, pricing, onboarding steps, contracts, and expectations clearly.

- Guide clients through the agreement, payment, and onboarding process.

- Coordinate with the operations team after the client signs up to ensure a smooth case handoff.

- Follow up with clients at key milestones, including after 24 hours, weekly updates, and service completion.

- Maintain accurate records in our dashboard, including lead status, call notes, messages, contracts, and follow-up tasks.

- Collect client feedback and reviews after successful service completion.

- Work reliably during your assigned shift to ensure fast response coverage.



* What We’re Looking For:

- At least 2 years of phone-based sales, customer service, client consultation, call center, or account support experience.

- Clear spoken English and the ability to communicate confidently with US-based clients.

- Calm, mature, and professional phone manner.

- Strong empathy and emotional control when speaking with distressed clients.

- Ability to guide a conversation without sounding pushy or aggressive.

- Experience handling objections, pricing conversations, and follow-ups.

- Strong reliability. Late starts, missed shifts, and no-shows directly affect client response times.

- Ability to fully commit to this role as your primary work commitment.

- Fast and stable internet connection.

- Quiet workspace suitable for professional calls.

- Own computer, headset, and microphone.

- Comfortable using CRM, dashboard, messaging, and calling tools.



* Nice to Have:

- Experience in legal services, insurance, cybersecurity, financial services, healthcare support, emergency support, trust and safety, or crisis-related customer service.

- Previous experience working with US-based clients.

- Inbound sales, client advisory, retention, or customer success background.

- Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Notion, GoHighLevel, Slack, WhatsApp Business, Aircall, RingCentral, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

- Experience in sensitive client conversations where confidentiality, trust, and clear communication are important.



* Priority Shift Schedule:

- We are currently prioritizing candidates for Shift B (4:00 AM – 12:00 PM Manila Time / PHT). Candidates must be consistently available during the full assigned shift.



* Compensation & Growth:

- Base salary: $800/month

- Commission: 3%–10% on closed deals, depending on monthly performance and collected revenue.

- Additional performance incentives may include client review bonuses and other performance-based rewards.

- Top performers may be promoted to Senior Client Advisor / Team Lead, with a base salary increase and additional training responsibilities.



* Employee Benefits:

- Monthly base salary + tiered commission.

- $10 bonus per verified customer review.

- $300 retention bonus every 3 months of tenure.

- 13th month pay: 1× base salary, paid by December 20, soft-conditional on hitting average commission performance.

- 10 days paid annual leave per year.

- 3 days paid sick leave per year, no doctor’s note required.

- 2× pay if you work on Philippine regular public holidays.

- Full Sunday off, guaranteed weekly rest day.



* Hiring Process:

- Application review.

- Resume/CV and voice recording review.

- Written screening assessment.

- Live interview with scenario-based questions.

- Reference/profile check.

- Offer, NDA, agreement, and onboarding.



* How to Apply:

- Please submit your resume/CV and a 60-second English voice recording.



* In your recording, please include:

- A brief introduction of yourself.

- Why you believe you are a strong fit for this role.

- A short summary of your phone-based sales, customer service, call center, client consultation, or account support experience.

- Confirmation that you can fully commit to this role during Shift B and that this will not be treated as a second job.

title: Customer Success/ Support E-Commerce
description:
About Nordmut

Nordmut is a growing e?commerce company based in Hamburg, focused on delivering high?quality products and a seamless online shopping experience to our customers. We combine data?driven decision making with a strong customer focus to build long?term relationships and sustainable growth.



Role Overview

As a Customer Success Manager at Nordmut, you are responsible for ensuring that our B2C customers achieve their desired outcomes with our products and services and enjoy a consistently excellent experience across all touchpoints. You will own the post?purchase relationship, drive adoption and retention, and act as the main link between our customers and internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations.



Key Responsibilities

Own and manage a portfolio of customers, building strong, long?term relationships and acting as their primary point of contact.



Monitor customer health, usage, and feedback using our CRM and analytics tools, and proactively engage customers to prevent churn and increase satisfaction.



Conduct regular business reviews (e.g. QBRs) to discuss performance, optimization opportunities, and strategic next steps with key accounts.



Work closely with our Support team to ensure fast, high?quality resolution of operational and technical issues and communicate clearly with customers throughout.



Collect, structure, and share customer feedback with Product, Marketing, and Operations to improve our assortment, online shop experience, and services.



Contribute to scalable customer?facing assets such as help center content, playbooks, FAQs, and best?practice guides for our e?commerce offerings.



Track and report on key customer success metrics (NPS, retention, expansion, order frequency, return rate, etc.) and derive concrete action plans.



Requirements

2–4 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, E?Commerce Management, or a similar customer?facing role, ideally in an online retail or digital environment.



Strong customer orientation, with the ability to understand business goals, translate them into concrete actions, and build trust?based relationships.



Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; German language skills are a strong plus.



Solid analytical skills, confidence working with data, and experience using CRM or CS tools and dashboards (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar).



Good understanding of e?commerce processes (traffic, conversion, merchandising, fulfillment, returns) and customer lifecycle management.



Proactive, solution?oriented working style with strong ownership, prioritization, and time management skills.



Ability to work cross?functionally and coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations teams.



What We Offer

The opportunity to shape the customer success function at Nordmut and have a direct impact on customer satisfaction and company growth.



A dynamic e?commerce environment with short decision paths and a high degree of autonomy.



A collaborative team culture, flexible working arrangements, and modern tools to support your work.



An office in Hamburg plus the option to work remotely several days per week.



If you are passionate about building strong customer relationships in e?commerce and want to help our customers and Nordmut grow together, we look forward to your application.

• Implement feedback quickly and accurately

• Deliver projects reliably and on time



A typical customer project may include approximately 8 individual videos. Each video is usually delivered in three formats, resulting in around 24 final exports. The videos are generally 40–60 seconds long and require subtitles, branding, suitable music, clean audio, and format-specific adjustments. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

• Ability to work independently from a detailed briefing

• Reliable communication and consistent availability

• Good English communication skills

• Adobe After Effects

 or similar feedback tools

OUR EXPECTATIONS

Our videos should feel authentic, modern, professional, approachable, and emotionally engaging. Static footage, unnecessary effects, visible third-party brands, poor audio, and incorrect subtitles must be avoided. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

title: Long-Term YouTube Video Editor – AI, Automation and Business Content
description:
Are you an experienced video editor who wants a stable, long-term role and the opportunity to help build a professional YouTube channel from the beginning?



I am creating a new YouTube channel focused on AI, business automation and digital enablement. The videos will demonstrate real automation projects, explain AI tools and workflows, and show businesses how technology can improve their operations.



This is not a channel built around generic stock footage and flashy transitions. The content needs to look polished, credible and professional because the channel will also represent my consulting and automation business.



1. Your Responsibilities:

You will be responsible for editing primarily long-form YouTube videos, with occasional short-form content.



Your work may include:

- Editing talking-head footage and screen recordings

- Creating clear motion graphics and visual explanations

- Illustrating workflows, systems, data flows and business processes

- Improving pacing and storytelling

- Cleaning and enhancing audio

- Adding appropriate music and sound design

- Creating professional YouTube thumbnails

- Repurposing selected content into Shorts when required



The videos will often be educational and technical. You should be able to make complicated topics easy to understand without making the editing feel childish or overly distracting.



2. What I’m Looking For

- Strong experience editing professional YouTube content

- Experience creating custom motion graphics for educational or business videos

- Good understanding of pacing, viewer retention and storytelling

- Strong attention to detail

- Experience editing screen recordings, software demonstrations or tutorials

- Good sound-design and audio-cleanup skills

- Experience creating thumbnails in Photoshop, Canva or similar tools

- No generic AI-generated thumbnails or low-effort AI visuals

- Reliable communication and the ability to meet agreed deadlines

- Willingness to receive feedback and improve over time



Experience with AI, automation, SaaS, technology or business content is helpful, but not required.



3. What You’ll Get

- A stable, long-term working relationship

- Consistent work

- Remote work with flexible hours

- Competitive compensation based on your skills and experience

- Clear feedback and communication

- Opportunities to take on more responsibility as the channel grows

- The chance to help shape the style of a new professional YouTube channel



The expected workload is approximately 1–2 long-form YouTube videos per week, typically between 8 and 15 minutes, depending on the complexity of the edit and motion graphics required. There may also be occasional Shorts and thumbnail creation.



The priority is quality rather than meeting a fixed video quota. Some videos will require relatively straightforward editing, while others may involve more extensive motion graphics, visual explanations and sound design.



This position is currently part-time, but with the potential to grow into a full time position quickly if both sides feel comfortable.



4. How to Apply

Please include:

- Three examples of your best relevant editing work.

- A brief explanation of what you personally worked on in each example.

- Examples of motion graphics or educational visualizations you created.

- Examples of thumbnails you designed.

- The editing software you use.

- Your current availability

- A short explanation of how you would visually explain an automation where a customer submits a form, an AI analyzes the information and the result is saved in a CRM.

- Your favorite food, so I know you read the complete job post.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid test edit.



Please do not apply with generic portfolio links or a fully AI-generated application. I am looking for someone who is genuinely interested in building a high-quality channel and working together for the long term.

title: Full-Time Stair CAD/CAM Detailer (StairBiz / StairCon + Biesse b-solid) — USD $1,000–$1,200/month
description:
Type: Full-time, long-term, work from home

Salary: USD $1,000–$1,200 per month, depending on experience

Hours: Must overlap Australian business hours (AEST)



We are an established Australian manufacturer of premium custom timber staircases, and we are hiring a full-time stair detailer to join our team long term. You will take each job from site measurements to the finished CAD design in StairBiz or StairCon, then produce the CNC programs in Biesse b-solid for our two Biesse Rover machining centres (3-axis and 5-axis). Our production lead reviews your work before anything is cut, and you will be part of our production process every week — this is a stable, permanent role with a growing company, not project-by-project freelancing.



Requirements



Real experience detailing timber stairs — you understand winders, stringers, cut strings and handrails, not just general joinery

Commercial experience with StairBiz and/or StairCon

Biesse b-solid experience; 5-axis programming is a strong advantage

Good written English and reliable full-time availability during AEST hours



How to apply: answer all five questions below in your application. Applications that do not answer them will not be read.



1- Software — Which stair design packages have you used commercially (StairBiz, StairCon, or others)? Roughly how many stair projects have you detailed in each?

2- End-to-end experience — Describe one stair project you personally took from site measurements to finished cut files. What type of stair was it, what software did you use at each stage, and what machine did it run on?

3- Stairs knowledge — A job calls for a cut-string stair with three winders at the bottom turn and a continuous handrail over the turn. How would you set out the winders, and what do you watch for in the handrail transition?

4- b-solid — Describe your experience programming in Biesse b-solid. Which Biesse machines have you programmed for, and which operations (routing, boring, nesting, 5-axis trimming)?

5- Five-axis — Give an example of a stair component that required 5-axis machining and explain how you approached the toolpaths.

title: Wix Developer
description:
About the Role



Next Wave Services is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Wix Developer to join our growing team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing websites built on the Wix platform for a variety of clients across multiple industries. The ideal candidate has strong experience with Wix Studio, responsive web design, custom functionality, SEO best practices, and website performance optimization. This individual should be comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment, collaborating with account managers, designers, marketers, and clients to deliver high-quality websites that drive results.



Key Responsibilities

Website Development & Maintenance

Build, customize, and maintain websites using Wix and Wix Studio.

Develop responsive websites that function seamlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Implement website updates, content changes, and enhancements based on client requests.

Troubleshoot website issues and resolve bugs in a timely manner.

Perform routine website maintenance, testing, and quality assurance.



Custom Functionality & Integrations

Utilize Velo by Wix to create custom functionality and dynamic website features.

Integrate third-party applications, forms, CRM systems, booking tools, payment gateways, and marketing platforms.

Configure and manage databases, collections, and dynamic pages within Wix.

Develop custom workflows and automation solutions to improve website functionality.



SEO & Performance Optimization

Implement on-page SEO best practices, including metadata, redirects, structured content, and site architecture.

Optimize website speed, performance, and user experience.

Ensure websites meet accessibility standards and industry best practices.

Monitor and address technical SEO issues as needed.



Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with Account Managers to understand client goals, requirements, and project priorities.

Collaborate with designers and marketing team members to ensure websites align with branding and campaign objectives.

Provide technical recommendations and solutions to improve website performance and functionality.

Participate in team meetings and communicate project progress, timelines, and potential roadblocks.



Quality Assurance

Conduct thorough testing before website launches and updates.

Verify functionality, responsiveness, forms, integrations, and user experience across devices and browsers.

Ensure all deliverables meet Next Wave Services' quality standards before deployment.



Qualifications

2+ years of experience building and managing websites on Wix or Wix Studio.

Experience with Velo by Wix and custom code implementation.

Strong understanding of responsive web design principles.

Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web development best practices.

Experience with SEO fundamentals and website optimization.

Familiarity with CRM systems, marketing integrations, automation tools, and third-party applications.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

Excellent communication and organizational skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a remote work environment.

Experience migrating websites from other platforms to Wix.

Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and related reporting tools.

Ability to read, write, and speak in English. 

Knowledge of UX/UI best practices and conversion-focused website design.

Experience with API integrations and advanced automation workflows.

A developer who takes pride in creating clean, high-performing websites.

A proactive problem-solver who can identify issues before they become problems.

Someone who values both design and functionality.

A team player who communicates effectively and thrives in a collaborative remote environment.

An individual who is committed to delivering exceptional results and creating a great experience for our clients.

Someone who can effectively balance client needs with internal team resources and priorities.

A dependable professional who takes ownership of client satisfaction and long-term account success.

title: High-Performance Executive Assistant
description:
This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.



We are looking for a high-performance operator who can combine data intelligence with operational execution and work directly alongside a fast-moving, visionary leader.



This role is for someone who can bring structure to data, clarity to decisions, and execution to leadership initiatives.



If you thrive in fast environments, think analytically, and operate with ownership, keep reading.



Who We Are:



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to take responsibility rather than wait for instructions.



We value:

• Speed

• Accountability

• Emotional maturity

• Precision

• Ownership

• Loyalty to the mission (not ego)



What This Role Really Is:



This role combines Data Analysis + Executive Operations.



Your first responsibility is to bring order to data across the organization: Cleaning, structuring, and translating it into clear insights.



Once the data foundation is organized, you will operate as a high-level executive, helping leadership execute faster and smarter.



You will help:



• Clean, organize, and analyze business data

• Turn raw data into meaningful reports and insights

• Support leadership with decision-ready information

• Protect your leader’s time and priorities

• Enforce accountability across leadership initiatives

• Translate strategy into structured execution

• Identify problems before they become fires

• Move initiatives forward without constant direction

• Bring clarity to complex situations



You will sit close to leadership.

You will see how decisions are made.

You must handle that with professionalism, discretion, and maturity.



What This Role Is NOT



This role is not for someone who:



• Needs constant praise or reassurance

• Struggles with direct feedback

• Prefers slow corporate environments

• Gets overwhelmed by changing priorities

• Waits for instructions instead of solving problems

• Is uncomfortable working with data and systems

• Frequently job hops every year



We operate in a high-accountability environment.



If you need tone cushioning or excessive structure, this will likely feel uncomfortable.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days):



Within your first 90 days, you:



• Organize and clean key business data sets

• Create structured reporting for leadership decisions

• Build dashboards or reports that bring visibility to operations

• Run leadership meetings with clear structure and follow-through

• Anticipate your leader’s needs before they are spoken

• Track priorities and ensure accountability across teams

• Bring solutions instead of just raising issues

• Operate calmly and clearly under pressure



The Profile That Thrives Here



You likely:



• Have experience in data analysis, reporting, or business analytics

• Are comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and structured data

• Have supported a founder or senior executive before

• Have stayed 3+ years in at least one meaningful role

• Enjoy solving complex operational problems

• Can build systems and workflows from scratch

• Communicate clearly and directly

• Are emotionally regulated and professional under pressure

• Think in outcomes and insights, not just tasks



You are someone who:



• Notices patterns others miss

• Brings clarity where others see chaos

• Moves things forward without being asked twice



Compensation & Growth:



This role offers:



• Competitive compensation aligned with performance

• Direct exposure to executive decision-making

• The opportunity to shape internal systems and operations

• Long-term growth as the company scales



At DAP Brands, we reward impact and ownership, not just tenure.



Final Note



This role is for someone who wants to build, solve, and operate at a high level.



If you enjoy working with data, solving operational problems, and supporting leadership execution, this could be an excellent fit.



If you're looking for a comfortable, slow-paced corporate role, this probably isn't it.



But if you want to operate at a high level and help build something meaningful, apply on our website 
/careers and write MAVERICK before your name.

short-form video editor to turn long livestream recordings into high-retention

vertical clips for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

and this can become a full-time position.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

nts

  what will pop off, not just someone who can cut)

- Clip those 
nts and edit them into tight, punchy vertical videos

- Cut out dead space, pauses, and repeated sentences (the artist often

  repeats a line and builds on it — trim it down to only the best version)

- Add on-screen HOOK TEXT that stops the scroll

- Add clean, well-timed captions

- Apply skin smoothing/softening

FROM ONE RECORDING: I expect around 10 usable, high-quality clips. Not 10

random cuts — 10 that are actually good.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent English (you must understand jokes, slang, and timing to know

  what's funny and clippable)

- Strong eye for viral short-form 
nts and retention editing

  for its captions and skin-smoothing.

- Comfortable downloading and working with large, multi-hour video files

  at the latest.



BIG BONUSES (not required, but they'll make you stand out)

PAY & SCHEDULE

- Part-time to start, around $400/month, with room to grow into full-time

  and higher pay as volume and trust increase

- First engagement is a short PAID test edit so we both know it's a fit

HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — applications that skip these are deleted)

1. Start your application with the word CLIPPED so I know you read the whole post.

2. Link 2–3 of your best VERTICAL short-form clips (not long-form, not

   wedding/corporate work — show me clips like what this role needs).

3. In a few sentences, tell me how you d
 which 
nts from a long

   video are worth clipping and the most important things to remember when editing for short form content

4. Tell me which software you'll use (CapCut Pro or Premiere) and your

   internet download speed.



I read every application that follows these steps. Looking forward to seeing

your work.

title: Shopify Store Growth Manager | Shopify + Meta Ads | Product Research to Scaled Sales
description:
**Ecommerce Growth Operator | Shopify + Meta Ads | Product Research to Scaled Sales**



---



We are building a profitable ecommerce operation and we need someone who can find winning products, build fast converting Shopify stores around them, and scale them with Meta ads. We are not locked into one niche right now. We are in the phase of finding what sells, scaling what works, and building from there. The niche will follow the data.



This is not a task based VA role. This is an operator role. You find the product, build the store, launch the ads, and make the kill or scale call. All of it.



---



**What success looks like**



A validated product with a live Shopify store within the first few days. First sales within the first two weeks. A clear data backed decision to kill or scale. Then on to the next one.



---



**What you will actually be doing**



You will research products across multiple categories using more than one tool and more than one method. You are looking for products that are already selling, already have proven demand, and have room to compete. You validate through revenue data, active ad counts, ad run duration, and competition levels before a single dollar is spent.



Once you find a winner you build a dedicated Shopify store around it fast. Premium conversion focused theme, landing page built around the transformation result, bundle pricing to increase order value, trust elements, and a clean mobile experience.



Before ads go live you set up tracking properly.
 Business Manager, pixel installation, event verification, and a secondary attribution tool to cross check your data. You do not launch on unverified tracking.



Then you launch. Structured test budget, CBO or ABO depending on the stage, proven video creatives from the research phase as primary ads, static image ads as support. You monitor daily. CPM, CTR, add to cart, cost per purchase. You make kill or scale decisions based on the numbers not your gut. You never scale more than 30 percent per day.



---



**Tools you need to have real experience with**



For product research: Kalodata, PipiAds,
 Ads Library, and organic TikTok scrolling to catch what is trending before it shows up in the data tools. Cross referencing multiple sources is non-negotiable.



For store building: Shopify and premium conversion focused themes such as Shrine or Elixir.



For tracking and ads:
 Business Manager including pixel setup and event verification, plus a secondary independent attribution tool such as WeTrack or Triple Whale.



For conversion: bundle pricing apps such as Kaching Bundle and subscription apps such as Loop Subscription.



For creative: Canva and AI image tools such as Midjourney or Adobe Firefly.



For daily workflow: AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude.



---



**Trial period and working hours**



This role starts with a 30 day paid trial. We want to see real execution and reliability before committing long term.



Required working hours during the trial: 7 PM to 1 AM CDT for real time collaboration. Communication will be through Slack throughout.



If the trial goes well we move into a long term role with a base rate plus performance upside tied to the sales you generate.



---



**You are the right person if**



You have personally researched and validated products before spending real ad budget using more than one tool. You have built a Shopify store from scratch fast without needing a template handed to you. You have launched and managed Meta ad campaigns and can walk us through real results. You can commit to the 7 PM to 1 AM CDT schedule for the full trial. You move fast and work independently once you understand the standards.



---



**You are not the right fit if**



You have never done product research on your own. You have never built a Shopify store independently. You have never managed a live ad account with real budget. You cannot commit to the required trial hours. You need heavy hand holding to get started.



---



**How to apply**



Start your application with the word SHOPIFY CHAMPION so we know you read this in full. Right after that in your first line tell us how many products you typically need to test to find one validated winner based on your own experience.



Then include the following:



A short plan for how you would approach your first product test with us from research through to launch including which tools you would use at each step and your estimated timeline to get a store live and ads running.



A specific product you personally researched and validated before including what data convinced you it was worth testing.



A Shopify store you built from scratch including the theme you used.



The attribution tool you use alongside
 Ads Manager and why.



A Meta ad campaign you ran the budget and what happened.



Applications with real specifics and a real plan will get a fast response. Generic ones will not.

title: Outbound BDM / Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Full-time | Remote | UK Market | Base + Performance Incentives



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Outbound BDM / Lead Generation Specialist to help grow our UK sales pipeline.



This is a phone-based cold calling role focused on researching businesses, identifying decision-makers, starting conversations, and booking qualified appointments with our director.



You will be speaking with UK-based business owners and directors, mainly from letting agencies, estate agencies, accounting firms, and other professional service businesses.



This role is not for someone looking for warm leads or a simple script-reading job. We are looking for someone who can think, research, open conversations naturally, handle objections, and book real appointments with qualified prospects.



If you are confident on the phone, comfortable speaking with business owners, and motivated by results, this could be a strong fit.



What You’ll Be Doing



Before making calls, you will research each business properly.



You will identify who runs the business, understand what they do, and approach each call with a clear reason for reaching out.



Your responsibilities will include:



Researching UK-based target businesses

Identifying business owners, directors, and key decision-makers

Making outbound cold calls to introduce our services

Creating your own call openers, hooks, and follow-up angles

Having real business conversations, not just reading from a script

Handling objections professionally and confidently

Booking qualified appointments with our director

Following up with prospects who are interested but not ready yet

Nurturing leads through phone,
, and other follow-up activity

Keeping accurate records of calls, outcomes, and next steps

Working consistently toward appointment-setting and sales targets



The businesses you will be calling are usually owner-led or director-led companies that are stretched with admin, operations, and back-office workload.



You will be expected to learn the offer well enough to speak naturally and confidently about how we can help them save time, increase capacity, and improve business efficiency.



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who has done genuine B2B cold calling before.



Ideally, you have experience calling UK, Australian, or US markets and are confident speaking with business owners, directors, and decision-makers.



You should be someone who:



Has proven experience in B2B cold calling

Has experience booking qualified appointments

Can work a prospect list properly, not just read from a script

Has strong spoken English

Has a natural, professional phone presence

Does not sound robotic or overly scripted

Can handle rejection without getting rattled

Knows how to keep a conversation going when someone says no

Can think creatively about openers, objections, and follow-ups

Is organised, consistent, and accountable with daily outbound activity

Is motivated by results and performance incentives



Experience in property, real estate, professional services, business services, or appointment setting is a bonus, but not required.



What matters most is that you have successfully booked qualified B2B appointments before and can show it.



Compensation



The base rate is $7 to $10 AUD per hour, depending on your experience and what you can demonstrate.



On top of your base rate, you will earn:



$10 AUD for every qualified appointment that shows up

$200 AUD for every client that signs on



A strong performer booking 10 to 15 appointments per month, with a reasonable conversion rate, can earn well above the base rate.



Work Setup

Full-time role

Remote work

UK market

Phone-based outbound sales

Performance incentives available

Long-term opportunity for the right person

title: AI Video Content Creator – Google Flow, HeyGen & ElevenLabs
description:
# AI Video Content Creator – Google Flow, HeyGen & ElevenLabs



**Type of Work:** Part-Time, long-term

**Hours:** Approximately 20 hours per week initially

**Schedule:** Flexible, with consistent production deadlines

**Compensation:** $3 USD per approved video, plus performance and volume bonuses



## About the Role



We are a growing content media agency that creates short-form affiliate videos for products.



We are looking for a reliable and creative AI Video Content Creator who can use generative AI tools to produce engaging TikTok, Instagram Reel, and
 Reel content.



Our videos may include AI-generated characters, talking avatars, voiceovers, product scenes, image-to-video generations, AI B-roll, and other synthetic media.



We currently use tools such as:



* Google Flow

* Google Veo

* HeyGen

* ElevenLabs

* CapCut or similar editing software

* Additional AI video, image, voice, and automation platforms



We will teach you our current production process, including the prompts, templates, tools, examples, and standard operating procedures we use.



Previous experience with these tools is strongly preferred, but it is not required if you are technically capable, learn quickly, and can follow detailed instructions.



## Your Responsibilities



* Create short-form AI videos for affiliate campaigns.

* Generate AI characters, scenes, product demonstrations, B-roll, and other visual assets.

* Create realistic AI voiceovers using tools such as ElevenLabs.

* Create talking-character or lip-synced videos using tools such as HeyGen.

* Use Google Flow, Veo, and similar platforms to generate video clips.

* Write and improve prompts based on our instructions and reference examples.

* Maintain character, clothing, environment, and visual consistency across generations.

* Combine generated assets into polished vertical videos.

* Add captions, sound effects, music, transitions, hooks, and on-screen text.

* Follow scripts, shot lists, prompts, templates, and reference videos.

* Identify generation errors such as unnatural movements, distorted hands, incorrect products, inconsistent characters, or poor lip-sync.

* Regenerate or correct assets when the quality does not meet our standards.

* Organize generated files, project files, prompts, and final exports.

* Track assigned and completed videos inside our content management system.

* Make reasonable revisions based on feedback.

* Meet agreed daily and weekly production targets.



You will not normally be responsible for posting the videos. Your primary responsibility will be creating and delivering finished content.



## Requirements



* Strong interest in AI content creation and generative media.

* Experience with at least one AI image, video, avatar, or voice-generation platform.

* Basic short-form video-editing ability using CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar software.

* Good written English and the ability to understand English scripts.

* Ability to write, test, and improve AI prompts.

* Strong attention to visual details and continuity.

* Ability to recognize when an AI generation looks unnatural or unusable.

* Ability to follow a repeatable production process.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Consistent communication and ability to meet deadlines.

* Willingness to receive feedback and improve quickly.



## Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:



* Google Flow or Google Veo

* HeyGen

* ElevenLabs

* AI image-generation platforms

* Image-to-video generation

* AI avatars and talking characters

* Character-consistency workflows

* AI voice cloning or text-to-speech

* Affiliate content

* UGC-style product advertisements

* Viral hooks and short-form storytelling

* CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro

* Prompt engineering

* E-commerce or direct-response advertising



You do not need experience with every platform listed. We care more about your ability to learn tools quickly, follow our systems, and consistently produce high-quality content.



## Compensation



Compensation ranges from **$3 USD per approved video**, depending on the complexity of the assignment.



Compensation may also include:



* Volume bonuses

* Reliability bonuses

* Performance bonuses

* Rate increases for consistently strong work

* Additional responsibilities for top-performing tea
mbers



Access to the AI tools required for our production process will be provided or arranged by the company.



One reasonable revision is normally included. Additional revisions caused by changed instructions may be compensated separately. Corrections required because the original instructions were not followed are not considered additional paid revisions.



## Training



We will provide training on:



* Our content strategy

* Our AI production workflow

* Prompt structures

* Character and scene creation

* Voice-generation settings

* Video-generation settings

* File organization

* Quality-control standards

* Editing templates

* Examples of successful videos

* Common AI-generation mistakes to avoid



You should be comfortable learning new software because the AI content-creation industry changes quickly and we may introduce additional tools over time.



## Paid Test Assignment



Shortlisted applicants will receive a small paid test assignment.



We may provide:



* A script

* A reference video

* Character images

* Product information

* Prompt examples

* A production brief

* Access to the required tools



The test will evaluate:



* Ability to follow instructions

* AI-generation quality

* Prompt-writing ability

* Character and visual consistency

* Video pacing and editing

* Attention to detail

* Communication

* File organization

* Turnaround time

* Ability to apply feedback



The paid test does not guarantee a permanent position.



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words **“AI VIDEO CREATOR”** so we know you read the full job description.



Include the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Links to 2–4 AI-generated videos or short-form videos you personally created.

3. A clear explanation of what you used to create those videos.

4. A list of the AI tools you have used.

5. Your experience with Google Flow, Veo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, AI avatars, or AI voice-generation tools.
