title: Virtual Executive Assistant — Dispatcher (AI-Powered Executive Office)
description:
Remote | Full-time | Based in the Philippines | 



Day & night shifts — 24-hour weekday coverage



We are hiring two dispatchers — one for each shift. Know someone who'd be perfect for the opposite shift?

We strongly encourage pairs — friends or former colleagues who already work well together — to apply

together. A two-person handover team runs best on existing trust.



About the role

You'll be the command center for a Malaysia-based CEO whose ideas and requests come in around the clock

— by voice notes captured on a wearable AI device, and by messages in
. Nothing moves until

someone catches the request, makes it clear, sends it to the right person, and confirms it's done. That

someone is you.



You'll run a purpose-built system that combines
, Airtable, Notion, and a custom AI assistant. And you

won't just use the AI — you'll train it. Every rule you write and every task you refine teaches the system to

handle more on its own. If you want a front-row seat to AI-assisted operations rather than traditional admin

work, this is that role.



The requests span the CEO's business and personal life: scheduling and appointments, travel, wellness

sessions, VIP guests, household errands, drivers, and purchases. Two on-the-ground assistants handle the

heavy lifting — anything physical, in-person, or long-running. But this is not a "dispatch only" desk: roughly

80% of your time goes to running the system, and around 20% goes to completing quick tasks yourself —

research, outreach, bookings, calendar work — whenever doing it is faster than routing it. You'll know the

CEO's calendar cold, resolve what you can at your level, and make sure everything else reaches the right

person clearly, on time, and gets closed out.



What you'll do

? Catch everything. Monitor the
 workspace continuously during your shift and acknowledge

new requests within minutes. Speed of response is the heart of this job.

? Triage. Sort each request by urgency — now, today, or later — and flag urgent items to the team

immediately.

? Decipher what the boss wants. Turn shorthand, voice notes, and half-sentences into complete,

unambiguous tasks. If details are missing, hold the task and get answers from the CEO first, so no one

has to guess — and over time, learn his patterns, preferences, and routines so you get it right with

fewer questions.

? Assign clearly. Send each task to the right assistant with a complete write-up: what's needed, by

when, and any specifics — taking their schedules and workload into account.

? Own the calendar. Know the CEO's schedule cold — check it before assigning or confirming anything,

catch conflicts early, and answer schedule questions directly instead of passing them on.

? Complete dispatcher-level tasks (~20% of your time). Quick research, outreach calls and

messages, no-payment bookings, drafting, and digital admin — see the scope section below. If it's

faster to do it than to route it, you do it.

? Keep the record clean. Maintain Airtable as the single source of truth: owner, category, due time,

status, and completion notes on every task.

? Close the loop. Follow up on open tasks, chase updates before the CEO has to ask, and make sure

completed tasks post to the completions feed with proper notes.

? Keep Notion current. Document rules, preferences, SOPs, and how-tos as you learn them — Notion

is the AI's knowledge base, and it's only as good as what you feed it.

? Monitor and train the AI. Watch how the AI assistant sorts, drafts, and routes tasks; correct its

mistakes and refine its rules so it gets smarter every week.

? Raise tickets on system issues. When the AI mis-sorts something, an automation breaks, or data

looks wrong, log a clear ticket for the maintenance team: what happened, where, and how to reproduce

it. You are the system's eyes.

? Bridge to offline channels. Route requests that live outside the system (e.g., contacting drivers via

WhatsApp).

? Hand over cleanly. Brief the incoming dispatcher at shift change so nothing is dropped between shifts.



Dispatcher-level tasks — what's in scope

Dispatching always comes first, but "I only dispatch" is not part of this role. The working rule:



If it can be done from your phone or computer in roughly 30 minutes or less, without

spending money and without being physically present — and the queue stays covered —

it's yours.



In scope (you handle these directly):

? Research: comparing options, finding contact details, checking prices, availability, and reviews, and

summarizing what you found.

? Outreach: calling or messaging restaurants, clinics, hotels, vendors, and other third parties to ask,

confirm, reschedule, or book (where no payment is required).

? Calendar work: checking availability, placing holds, sending invites, spotting conflicts.

? Digital admin: drafting messages, filling forms, compiling lists and links, chasing replies from external

parties.

? Answering the CEO directly when the answer already exists in the system (calendar, Airtable, past

notes) rather than routing the question.



Routed to the on-the-ground assistants:

? Anything physical or in-person: pickups, deliveries, setup, being somewhere.

? Anything requiring payment or the company card.

? Long-running work that would pull you off the queue — you may start it, but hand it off rather than let

messages sit.



The priority rule: if a new request arrives while you're mid-task, acknowledge and triage first. The task waits

or gets rerouted — the queue never goes quiet.



The toolkit

 (your primary workspace), Airtable, Notion, ChatGPT, WhatsApp, Google Calendar, and Gmail. Full

training on the system is provided during onboarding — you'll work alongside the team that built it.



Schedule & coverage

We designed this schedule to be demanding where it matters and humane where it doesn't.

? Full-time, fully remote, anchored to Philippine Standard Time (GMT+8 — the same timezone as the

CEO in Malaysia, so no conversion ever).

? Weekdays (Mon–Fri): 8am-12am coverage between the two dispatchers

? Weekends: reduced coverage — half-day monitoring windows rather than full shifts, split between the

two of you however you agree. Most of every weekend is genuinely yours.

? Public holidays: off. In the exception is ever needed, it's arranged with you in advance

? The pace is honest: requests arrive in waves, with quiet stretches. What we measure is how fast and

how well you handle what comes in — not how busy you look.

? If a shift ever can't be covered (illness, family emergency), a fallback flow routes requests directly to the

on-the-ground assistants. Coverage is planned seriously, communication is key.

? During your shift, being reachable and responsive is the core of the job. The role isn't compatible with a

second job or other commitments during shift hours.

Must-haves

? Fluent English, written and spoken. You'll be communicating directly with the CEO and coordinating a

team all day.

? Exceptionally organized. You keep clean records without being reminded and nothing slips past you.

? Very responsive by nature. You're the kind of person who replies fast, follows up without being asked,

and finds unanswered messages genuinely uncomfortable.

? Comfortable with AI. You already use tools like ChatGPT and are excited to work with (and train) an

AI assistant daily.

? Clear, concise writing. You can turn a rambling voice note into a crisp task brief.

? Proactive judgment. You ask the right clarifying questions — including to a CEO — rather than

guessing.

? No-task-too-small attitude. You'd rather knock out a quick booking or research task yourself than say

"that's not my job."

? Discretion. You'll handle personal and business information and must be comfortable signing an NDA.

? Reliable remote work setup (see equipment below).

Equipment & workspace — you provide

? Your own computer/laptop and smartphone in good working condition.

? Stable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps) with a backup connection (e.g., mobile data).

? Reliable power, with a backup plan for outages.

? A quiet environment where you can focus for a full shift.



Nice to have

? Prior experience as a virtual assistant, executive assistant, dispatcher, or coordinator — especially

supporting a founder, executive, or busy household.

? Hands-on experience with Airtable, Notion, or
-based workflows.

? Experience writing prompts, SOPs, or training/configuring AI tools.

? Customer service or operations background where fast response times were measured.



Compensation & terms

? Monthly salary: starting salary is ?45,000 with opportunity advancement and bonuses

? Eligible for equipment allowance starting at 6 months

? Engagement type: Independent contractor

? Paid onboarding and training while the system goes live, working directly with the build team.

? Long-term role with room to grow as the system scales to support more of the executive office.



How to apply

Send your application to 
/HR contact] with the subject line: Dispatcher — [Your Name]

Include:

1. Your CV (PDF).

2. A 60–90 second voice note introduction in English — Introduce yourself and share why you want to

have this role.

3. A screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net) and a one-line description of your computer

and phone devices.

4. Your preferred shift times and earliest start date.

5. Applying as a pair? Tell us who you're applying with, how you know each other, and which of you

takes which shift. Pairs who can trade shifts and cover for each other are a real plus.

Applications that follow these instructions exactly will be prioritized — attention to detail starts here.

title: Customer Service & Community Manager
description:
About Us

We're Fearless Swimwear — an Australian e-commerce swimwear brand built on making women feel confident and comfortable in their bodies. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and the way we talk to them matters: friendly, casual, empathetic, empowering, and real. We're a small, close-knit team, and we're looking for someone who genuinely cares about people to be the voice our customers hear.



This is a long-term role for the right person. If you love helping people, take pride in a tidy inbox, and want to grow with a brand that treats its team well — we'd love to meet you.





What You'll Do

Customer Success & Experience

Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries via
, chat, and social media, ensuring timely, warm, and solution-focused responses.

Uphold the Fearless brand voice — friendly, casual, empathetic, empowering, and real — in all customer communications.

Manage returns, exchanges, and fit-related queries in line with Fearless policies, ensuring customers feel supported and satisfied.

Anticipate and identify recurring issues or customer pain points, and proactively suggest process improvements.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in customer support tools and systems.

Monitor inventory-related inquiries and liaise with the operations team to resolve stock or fulfillment issues.

Track and report key customer service metrics (response time, satisfaction rate, common issues) to leadership.

Support launches, campaigns, or special projects requiring customer communication and feedback coordination.





What We're Looking For

Excellent written English — clear, warm, and natural. This is the #1 requirement. You'll be the voice of our brand.

Previous customer service experience, ideally for an e-commerce, retail, or DTC brand.

A genuine, empathetic communicator who can stay calm, kind, and professional — even with a frustrated customer.

Organised and reliable — you follow up, you keep records tidy, and things don't slip through the cracks.

Proactive problem-solver who spots patterns and suggests better ways of doing things, rather than just clearing tickets.

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision, and communicating clearly with a remote team.

Stable internet connection and a quiet space to work.

Must Have Experience

Previous e-commece experience working for apparel/fashion brand

Help Desk Software  ( — Gorgias, Re-Amaze, Zendesk, Gladly, etc.)

Shopify — order lookups, returns, exchanges, refunds

Instagram / social media DMs & comments

Gmail & Slack for communication and internal coordination





Why You'll Like Working With Us

A supportive, friendly team that values you as a person, not just a worker.

Long-term, stable role with room to grow as the brand grows.

Meaningful work for a brand with a mission you can feel good about.

Clear processes and a leader who communicates well and respects your time.





How to Apply

Please don't send a generic application — we read every one. To apply:



Start your reply with the word "CONFIDENT" so we know you read this whole post.

Briefly tell us about your customer service experience, especially any e-commerce or fashion/retail brands.

We're genuinely excited to find the right person. Applications that follow the steps above go straight to the top of our list.

title: Product Designer
description:
Job Summary:

KeaBabies is seeking a practical, execution-focused Product Designer to strengthen our design capabilities by translating customer needs, and market opportunities into supplier-feasible product improvements. Going beyond aesthetics, this role requires a deep understanding of real user pain points and the technical ability to deliver accurate, production-ready 3D/CAD/STP files from concept to final execution. Ultimately, you will accelerate our development pipeline and elevate the quality of products with proven demand, while working collaboratively to optimize the team's overall workload.



Note: This application requires a sample task. Only applicants who were able to complete the sample task will be shortlisted.



Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct market, consumer, and competitor research to identify customer pain points, product gaps, and improvement opportunities.

• Review Amazon customer feedback, especially 1-to-3 star reviews, to identify repeated complaints, usability issues, and competitor weaknesses.

• Develop practical product improvement ideas based on customer needs, market demand, competitor gaps, and supplier feasibility.

• Create sketches, moodboards, 3D models, CAD drawings, realistic renders, and product-ready STP/STEP files.

• Prepare supplier-ready design details, including dimensions, construction notes, material direction, and basic tech pack information.

• Work closely with the Senior Product Designer & Creative team to explore, refine, and finalize design directions.

• Revise designs based on internal feedback, supplier feasibility, sample reviews, cost considerations, and production limitations.

• Support supplier communication on material, construction, dimensions, feasibility, cost, timeline, and sample issues.

• Maintain proper file organization, naming, version control, and documentation according to internal SOPs.

• Communicate project progress, blockers, risks, and recommendations clearly and proactively.



Requirements:

• Minimum 2 years of working experience in product design, industrial design, or a related consumer product design role.

• Portfolio showing concept sketches, 3D models, product renders, and final product outcomes, preferably for baby, parenting, lifestyle, or consumer products.

• Strong product thinking with the ability to turn customer needs, competitor weaknesses, and market gaps into practical product improvement ideas.

• Able to communicate design intent clearly through hand sketches, storyboards, moodboards, CAD drawings, and visual presentations.

• Proficient in Photoshop, Illustrator, and 3D modeling tools such as SolidWorks or Fusion 360.

• Able to create accurate 3D models and product-ready STP/STEP files for supplier review and production development.

• Basic understanding of materials, construction, ergonomics, safety, dimensions, and supplier feasibility.

• Creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about baby products, with awareness of safety, usability, and customer experience.

title: Treasury & Reconciliation Analyst — Remote (Australian Lender)
description:
Treasury & Reconciliation Analyst — Remote (Australian Lender)



*Company:* Archer Wealth (Australian non-bank lender)

*Type:* Full-time or part-time · 100% remote

*Schedule:* Some overlap with Sydney business hours (AEST) — you're only ~2–3 hours behind us



---



About the role



Archer Wealth is an Australian non-bank lender. We're looking for a detail-obsessed *Treasury & Reconciliation Analyst* to make sure our numbers always match — across our loan management system, bank accounts, and portfolio reports. If you're the kind of person who can't rest until the last cent lines up, you'll fit right in.



What you'll do



- Reconcile loan and portfolio data (daily/weekly) across multiple systems — our loan management system, bank statements, and accounting records — and confirm everything matches.

- Investigate and document discrepancies ("breaks"): identify the cause and flag them clearly.

- Support month-end: loan balance checks, transaction matching (drawdowns, repayments, interest, fees), and arrears reviews.

- Help prepare and sanity-check portfolio and reporting data before it goes out.

- Maintain clean, well-organised reconciliation logs and working papers.

- Be a reliable second set of eyes — flag anything unusual promptly.

title: Land Acquisitions Manager Make up to $100K per year.
description:
Make up to $100k a year (Uncapped  Commission)



*THE ROLE*



You get on the phone with landowners, do real discovery to understand what they actually need, and propose the solution that solves it. You close, and you get paid on every deal that closes. Uncapped. The better you serve the seller, the more you close, and the more you make. That is the whole deal.



The people you help are usually landowners who inherited a piece of land, or bought it decades ago for a plan that never happened, and now it is just a bill and a worry they would like to be rid of. A lot of them have been burned before by someone who made a promise and vanished. They do not want a hard sell. They want an honest person who makes it simple and does exactly what they said they would.



Your job is to be that person, and here that's a specific kind of selling. You start by digging for what's really driving them, the real reason the land became a weight, not the surface answer. Then you help them see a way out they can trust. You win on trust, not pressure, and never by being the highest number. Price is a threshold to clear, not the lever you pull. The skill is getting a guarded, been-burned seller to a decision they'll feel good about long after the call. The reps who care the most close the most, because sellers can feel the difference between being served and being sold.



The standard for this seat is 4 signed deals a month.



*SKILLS NEEDED TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE*



- Fluent in speaking and writing English with minimal accent.

- Proven expertise with Land Insights, Land Portal, Land ID, Zillow, and Redfin for property comparables and research.

- Experience with Google Workspace, DocuSign, and CRM systems like Stride or Pebble.





*KEY RESPONSIBILITIES*



- Research land opportunities using GIS, public records, and online data sources.

- Analyze zoning, land use, density, and development code.

- Contact local planning & zoning departments to confirm zoning and development standards.

- Organize diligence materials and flag risks early.





*APPLICATION PROCESS*

Submit your resume.

Submit a video introducing yourself and also answer the following questions in the video as well (Loom or equivalent).



What is your experience using Land Insights, Land Portal, Land ID, Zillow or Redfin?

Have previously you worked in land investing or wholesaling real estate? If yes, describe your role.

If a Land seller tells you he want s to sell his 1 acre parcel for $40,000 but the land is worth $15,000. How do you negotiate with the seller?



*IMPORTANT*

*No video submission, your application will be discarded*



This a Fully commission role. No Base Salary.

- Drive retention and expansion: Prove the ROI of OpenCall every single month, enabling the customer to roll out additional locations. You will run monthly and quarterly reviews grounded in hard data: calls handled, hours saved, and appointments booked.

- Feedback loop: Act as the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams. You will help prioritize feature requests and flag drift or friction in live deployments before the customer even notices.



What we're looking for

- You've managed complex customers and onboardings before. You have 6+ years of experience as a CSM in a B2B SaaS or HealthTech company

- Deep empathy mixed with operational rigor. You stay organized when multiple projects are in flight. You understand that in healthcare workflows, a bad deployment costs real money for real practices, and you know how to manage expectations carefully.

- Exceptional communication. You can seamlessly translate highly technical AI concepts to a non-technical front-office manager, and then turn around and translate front-office operational chaos into clear requirements for our engineering team.

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (Full or partial US hours overlap required)



About OpenCall 



OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.



We are looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist who can rigorously pressure-test our AI agents and ensure they consistently deliver a flawless, human-like conversational experience for the medical and dental practices we serve. 



About the role



As a Quality Assurance Specialist at OpenCall, you are the final line of defense ensuring our AI voice agents sound natural, respond accurately, and navigate complex conversations flawlessly. This is a highly impactful, non-engineering role focused entirely on conversational quality and product reliability.



You will rigorously test both our inbound and outbound phone agents, actively trying to break them by introducing edge cases, unexpected questions, and complex medical scheduling scenarios. You will ensure our AI can handle the unpredictable nature of real human conversations before deployments go live for our medical and dental practices.



Responsibilities



- Conversational Testing: Conduct extensive manual testing of inbound and outbound AI voice agents over the phone, simulating real-world patient interactions, objections, and edge cases.



- Issue Identification & Reporting: Document bugs, prompt failures, unnatural pauses, and conversational dead-ends. You will translate these conversational breakdowns into clear, actionable reports for our engineering and prompt development teams.



- Call Auditing & Grading: Listen to and review call recordings and transcripts from live and test environments to grade AI performance against our strict quality and safety standards.



- Collaborative Iteration: Work closely with Agent Developers and Customer Success Managers to understand customer-specific workflows (like complex dental scheduling rules) and verify that the AI adheres to those precise constraints.



What we're looking for

- Extensive QA or relevant experience: You have 5+ years of experience in quality assurance, conversational design testing, contact center operations, or a highly rigorous analytical role.



- Exceptional English fluency: Because you are evaluating the nuances of spoken English—including tone, register, phrasing, and regional accents—native-level or highly fluent English speaking and listening skills are an absolute requirement.



- Meticulous attention to detail: You notice the subtle difference between an AI sounding "helpful" versus "robotic," and you possess the focus required to run through dozens of conversational flows without letting small errors slip through the cracks.



- Tech-savvy problem solver: You do not need to be an engineer or write code, but you must be highly comfortable working alongside technical teams, navigating internal dashboards, and utilizing modern software tools to log your findings.



Preferred Qualifications

- Full overlap with US business hours (partial overlap is acceptable for the ideal candidate).

- Prior experience testing voice AI, chatbots, LLMs, or working in conversational AI.

- Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical/dental scheduling workflows, or terminology.

title: DTC Creative Strategist
description:
We operate a fast-growing portfolio of digitally native consumer brands: our flagship brand Zoyava, in health and wellness supplements, and our sister brands in skincare and hair oils. We sell across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, DTC, and nationwide retail, with a steady pipeline of new product launches across all four brands. Our dedication to unparalleled quality and exceptional customer experience drives our operations, and we believe every employee's contribution is indispensable to our success.



Why This Role Exists



Paid social creative is the single biggest lever in scaling our products. Every new product we launch has one target: $1 million per month in revenue. We are hiring the person who owns the creative engine that gets each launch there. You will drive growth across all four brands and every new product in the pipeline — turning customer data, reviews, and market research into a relentless weekly stream of high-converting ad concepts across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube. You will not be the editor or the media buyer, but you will own the strategy that connects them: identifying winning angles, writing sharp briefs, directing creators and editors, and reading performance data to d
 what to scale, kill, or iterate.



What Success Looks Like in 12 Months



Every new product launch across Zoyava and our family of brands, ships with a full creative testing system from day one, and is on a measurable trajectory toward $1M/month.

Creative win rate (ads that beat account-average CPA/ROAS) improves quarter over quarter, with learnings documented in a living angle/hook library per brand and per product.

The creative pipeline never runs dry: media buyers across all four brands always have fresh, on-brand creative to test and scale.

Winning concepts are directly attributable to revenue, because your compensation depends on it.

Weekly Output Expectations

This is a high-volume, high-velocity role covering a four-brand portfolio, prioritized by the new product launch calendar. 



Steady-state expectations:



15–20 net-new ad concepts per week across the portfolio, weighted toward active and upcoming product launches, each grounded in a specific angle, audience insight, hook, and offer.

40–60 launched creative variations per week shipped through editors and UGC creators — new concepts plus iterations of proven winners.

12–15 detailed creative briefs per week for video editors, UGC creators, and designers, with hooks, scripts/outlines, references, and success criteria.

Launch sprints for every new product: a dedicated 20+ concept testing wave in the first 30 days of each launch to find scalable winners fast.

1 weekly creative performance review per brand: what won, what lost, why, and what the next testing sprint looks like.

24–48 hour feedback turnaround on all drafts to keep the production pipeline moving.



Key Responsibilities: 



Creative Strategy & Concepting

Own paid social creative strategy for all four brands — across Meta, TikTok, Snap, YouTube, and other DTC channels.

Own the creative side of every new product launch: positioning angles, launch hooks, offers, and the first-30-day testing wave.

Mine customer reviews, support tickets, competitor ads, and market trends to identify winning angles, hooks, and offers per brand and per product.

Build and maintain a rolling 4-week testing roadmap per brand, re-prioritized weekly around the launch calendar.

Maintain a swipe file and creative reference library of top-performing ads in supplements, skincare, haircare, and adjacent categories.



Briefing & Production Management



Write detailed, unambiguous creative briefs for video editors, UGC creators, and designers.

Source, brief, and direct UGC creators and influencers to produce authentic, conversion-focused, compliant content.

Manage the production pipeline to hit the weekly output targets above with fast turnaround and consistent quality.



Performance Analysis & Iteration



Partner with media buyers to track CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate, and thumb-stop rate by concept, angle, brand, and product.

Run a weekly scale/kill/iterate decision cadence and feed learnings directly into the next round of concepts.

Report creative performance, testing learnings, and revenue attribution of winning concepts to leadership on a weekly cadence.



Brand, Compliance & Collaboration



Keep all creative on-voice and on-brand for each of the four brands, adapted to each platform's native format.

Ensure ad compliance across supplements (health claims) and beauty/personal care (cosmetic claims) on every concept and brief.

Align creative with each brand's marketing calendar, promotions, and product launch schedule.



Required Qualifications



3+ years working strictly in creative strategy or creative direction for paid social — this is not an editor, media buyer, or generalist marketing role.

That experience must be with CPG or telehealth brands (supplements, health & wellness, beauty, or personal care strongly preferred).

Proven track record of concepting ads that drove measurable revenue — you will be asked to show 3–5 ads with the numbers (spend, CPA/ROAS, run time) and your hypothesis behind each.

Demonstrated ability to sustain a high-volume, multi-brand pipeline (15+ concepts/week) without sacrificing quality.

Experience supporting new product launches, not just scaling established products.

Strong command of Meta and TikTok ad formats, native best practices, and DTC customer psychology (hooks, angles, offers, awareness levels).

Fluent reading of paid social performance data to guide creative decisions.

Experience writing briefs and directing video editors and UGC creators.

Excellent written and verbal English; strong project management across a multi-brand pipeline.

Based in the Philippines with reliable internet; able to maintain at least 3–4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time for standups and media buyer syncs.

Comfortable with — and motivated by — a fully performance-based, independent contractor engagement. Your upside is uncapped and tied directly to the revenue your winning concepts generate.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with an omni-channel brand selling across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and DTC.

Experience running creative for multiple brands or a brand portfolio simultaneously.

title: Amazon Operations and Team Manager SOPs | KPIs | 3+ Years
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.

You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented --and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.

Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly, without the founders being involved in every daily decision.

If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems, keep reading.



What You'll Do:

- Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

- Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

- Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly

- Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

- Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

- Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

- Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

- Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

- Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

- Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

- Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

- Keep an eye on profitability alongside the founders

- Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Where the Founders Stay Involved

To be clear about where this role starts and stops: the Founders will continue to own overall company direction and priorities; brand, product, and market strategy; final decisions on launches, positioning, and pricing; approval of budgets, salaries, hiring/firing, and major investments; and review of high-level KPIs and reports.



This role owns everything else: the daily execution, systems, and team accountability that make those strategic decisions possible - including the follow-up, reminders, and day-to-day problem-solving that used to fall on the founders.



Tools You Must Know:

- ClickUp/ Monday etc - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

- Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

- Slack or similar - team communication

- Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

- Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



- 3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

- You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

title: Recruitment Resourcer
description:
Garry Howling Recruitment is a specialist recruitment business operating across the UK accountancy profession. We have ambitious plans to build a high-growth, market-leading recruitment company, and we are looking for an exceptional Recruitment Resourcer to play a central role in that growth.



This is not an administrative resourcing position, and it is not a role for someone who waits to be given a daily list of tasks. We need an exceptionally proactive, intelligent and commercially aware individual who naturally takes ownership, spots opportunities and makes things happen.



The successful person must take complete responsibility for every task and agreed action, progressing it promptly and following it through to its proper conclusion without needing to be chased. Sending an initial message, beginning a piece of research or simply reporting an opportunity will not, by itself, be regarded as completing the task. We need somebody who remains responsible until the intended outcome has been achieved, properly recorded and clearly communicated.



You will work closely with the business owner, supporting him by generating high-quality candidate conversations, identifying recruitment opportunities and progressing those opportunities as far as possible. You will undertake sourcing, research, initial engagement, qualification and follow-up, allowing the business owner to become the senior touchpoint with candidates and clients at the most commercially important stages.



The right person will be able to take a small piece of market information and turn it into a structured commercial plan. For example, if you discover that an accountancy firm is recruiting, you will not simply report that information. You will research the firm, identify the relevant decision-makers, understand its likely recruitment requirements, recommend an appropriate engagement strategy and take proactive steps to create a conversation, meeting or commercial opportunity.



You must be resourceful, progressive and comfortable working with significant independence. Success will be measured through conversations, meetings, candidates, opportunities and commercial outcomes—not simply by the number of tasks started or messages sent.



Key responsibilities



Candidate sourcing and engagement



• Proactively identify high-quality accountancy professionals who may be suitable for current or future opportunities.

• Build detailed talent pools across specific locations, disciplines and levels of seniority.

• Create persuasive, highly personalised approaches that generate genuine candidate interest.

• Engage professionally with potential candidates through appropriate online platforms,
, telephone and other suitable channels.

• Follow up intelligently and persistently without requiring reminders or continual direction.

• Conduct initial candidate qualification conversations to establish experience, qualifications, location, salary, notice period, career aspirations and reasons for considering a move.

• Obtain current CVs and relevant background information before booking candidates to speak with the business owner.

• Schedule qualified candidate meetings directly into the business owner’s diary.

• Maintain relationships with candidates who may not be ready to move immediately.

• Ask candidates for referrals and use market intelligence to identify further opportunities.

• Ensure candidate records, communications and activity notes are accurately maintained within the CRM.

• Continue progressing candidate relationships until an appropriate outcome or agreed follow-up position has been reached.



Market intelligence and opportunity creation



• Monitor the UK accountancy recruitment market and identify firms that are recruiting, growing, acquiring other businesses or likely to require recruitment support.

• Turn small pieces of information into practical, commercially focused action plans.

• Research prospective clients, including their structure, locations, vacancies, decision-makers and potential recruitment challenges.

• Develop tailored engagement approaches for individual firms rather than relying on generic messages.

• Initiate contact and work towards generating introductory meetings for the business owner.

• Recognise commercial opportunities arising from candidate conversations and market research.

• Progress every credible lead promptly rather than merely recording or reporting it.

• Follow commercial opportunities through until the intended action has been completed or a clear outcome has been achieved.

• Recommend new searches, campaigns, talent pools and market opportunities based on the information you uncover.

• Work collaboratively with the Marketing Manager to convert campaigns, responses and market visibility into candidate and client conversations.

• Identify obstacles affecting results, recommend solutions and adjust the approach when necessary.



Supporting the business owner



• Become a highly dependable extension of the business owner.

• Anticipate what needs to happen next and take appropriate action without waiting to be instructed.

• Protect the business owner’s time by completing research, initial engagement, qualification and follow-up before involving him.

• Provide concise, useful information that enables fast commercial decisions.

• Prepare the business owner thoroughly for candidate and client meetings.

• Follow up agreed actions immediately after meetings and ensure opportunities continue moving forward.

• Bring forward ideas, solutions and recommended actions—not simply questions or problems.

• Take responsibility for filling the business owner’s diary with worthwhile candidate and prospective-client conversations.

• Take complete ownership of assigned tasks and agreed actions, ensuring they are progressed promptly and followed through to full completion without requiring reminders.

• Remain responsible for each piece of work from the initial instruction through to the intended outcome.

• Proactively resolve obstacles and communicate promptly if additional information, authority or support is genuinely required.

• Never regard a task as complete simply because the first action has been taken; ensure the required outcome has been achieved, accurately recorded and clearly communicated.

• Maintain a reliable system for monitoring every commitment, deadline and follow-up so that nothing is overlooked or allowed to lose 
ntum.



The person we are looking for



The successful applicant must be:



• Extremely proactive: You naturally take action, follow through and continually look for the next opportunity.

• Accountable and completion-focused: You take personal ownership of every task and agreed action, follow it through to its proper conclusion and can be trusted to deliver without being chased.

• Commercially minded: You understand that the purpose of your work is to generate conversations, relationships, vacancies and placements.

• Resourceful: You can take limited information, research it properly and turn it into something commercially valuable.

• Highly independent: You can manage your workload and generate productive activity without constant supervision.

• Persistent: You follow up appropriately and do not allow worthwhile opportunities to disappear through lack of action.

• Intelligent and analytical: You can interpret information, identify connections and d
 on the most effective next step.

• An exceptional communicator: Your spoken and written English must be of an outstanding professional standard.

• Confident: You must be comfortable communicating with experienced UK professionals and senior business decision-makers.

• Organised: You can manage multiple searches, follow-ups, candidate relationships and commercial leads without losing 
ntum.

• Dependable: If you commit to completing something, the business owner can trust that it will be completed properly, on time and to the required standard.

• Adaptable: You respond positively to changing priorities and a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.

• Outcome-focused: You measure your success through tangible results rather than general activity.



Essential requirements



• Educated to degree level.

• Exceptional written and spoken English.

• Previous experience in recruitment sourcing, executive search, candidate generation, lead generation, business development or another relevant commercially focused role.

• Demonstrable experience of working independently and creating opportunities without waiting for detailed instructions.

• Evidence of taking ownership of work and following tasks through to full completion.

• Strong online research and market-mapping ability.

• Confidence in initiating professional conversations by telephone,
 and other communication channels.

• Ability to write persuasive and highly personalised outreach.

• Experience using a CRM or similar database system.

• Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping.

• A reliable, high-speed internet connection and professional home-working environment.

• Availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday. Local working hours will change when the UK moves between British Summer Time and Greenwich Mean Time.



Performance measures



Success in this role will be assessed through measurable commercial outcomes, including:



• Qualified candidate conversations generated.

• Candidate meetings booked and attended.

• High-quality candidates introduced against live and prospective vacancies.

• Updated CVs and candidate information obtained.

• Candidate relationships developed and reactivated.

• Recruitment leads and prospective clients identified.

• Introductory client meetings created.

• Quality and personalisation of outreach.

• Speed and consistency of follow-up.

• Completion of tasks and agreed actions without reminders.

• Accuracy and completeness of CRM records.

• Evidence of independent ideas, initiative and commercial ownership.

• Ability to turn limited information into valuable candidate or client opportunities.

• Contribution to the continued growth of the business.



What this role is not



This is not a general virtual assistant, data-entry or purely administrative position. It is not suitable for somebody who needs every task to be explained, waits for instructions or regards sending a message or beginning a task as the finished outcome.

We are looking for someone who asks:

“What commercial opportunity can I create from this information, what should happen next, and what can I do now to move it forward?”

The successful person will be ambitious, energetic and determined to become a key contributor to the development of a substantial UK recruitment business. This is an opportunity to work closely with an experienced recruitment business owner, take genuine responsibility and build a role with considerable long-term scope.



Engagement details



This is a full-time, self-employed independent contractor opportunity. The successful applicant will not be employed directly by Garry Howling Recruitment and will be responsible for managing and paying their own tax, statutory contributions, insurance and any other obligations arising in their country of residence.



The contractor will be expected to provide their own suitable computer equipment, reliable high-speed internet connection and professional home-working environment.



The role requires availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday. Working hours in the contractor’s location will therefore change when the UK moves between British Summer Time and Greenwich Mean Time.

Although this is an independent contractor position, we are looking for someone who wants to work closely with the business owner and wider team and make a significant, long-term contribution to the growth of Garry Howling Recruitment.



Application process



The application process is expected to include:



1. CV/resume submission and initial application review.

2. Shortlisting of selected applicants.

3. Short video introduction of approximately two to four minutes, requested from shortlisted applicants only.

4. Initial interview.

5. Practical assessment task.

6. Final interview.

7. Independent contractor offer.



Applicants who progress through the process may be asked to demonstrate their:



• Research and market-mapping ability.

• Written and spoken communication.

• Commercial judgement and initiative.

• Candidate engagement skills.

• Ability to turn limited information into a practical commercial plan.

• Approach to following tasks and opportunities through to completion.

• Ability to create activity and commercial opportunities without continual direction.

• Confidence when conducting a mock candidate conversation.



All information and work submitted during the application process must be the applicant’s own and must accurately represent their experience and capabilities.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
BestPerfume.Store is hiring a skilled short-form video editor for Meta:
 and Instagram Reels.



This role is **short-form editing only**



## Work Volume



* 3–5 finished videos per week

* Multiple hook variations from the same footage

* Primarily 15–45 second videos

* Consistent ongoing work



## What You Will Edit



* UGC-style videos

* Founder-led videos

* Product demonstrations

* Talking-head content

* Short-form advertisements

* Multiple hook variations from the same core video



## What Good Editing Means to Us



You must know how to:

* Remove dead space without making speech feel unnatural

* Improve pacing and viewer retention

* Select the strongest takes

* Identify weak framing, lighting, positioning and delivery

* Use zooms, cuts, sound effects and motion graphics selectively

* Add subtitles that are clean and easy to read

* Use B-roll and product footage with purpose

* Improve weak footage where realistically possible

* Make content feel native to social media—not like a corporate video

* Keep editing polished without making it loud, childish or cringe

* Add relevant b-roll to reflect what is being said



We prefer editors with good judgment over editors who use the most effects.



## Requirements



* Strong portfolio of short-form content

* Experience editing Reels, TikToks or short-form advertisements

* Strong understanding of pacing, hooks and viewer retention

* Good visual judgment

* Able to identify problems in footage, not just follow instructions

* Reliable communication

* Able to meet deadlines consistently

* Comfortable receiving direct feedback

* Proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or equivalent professional software

* Must provide editable project files when requested



## Important



Do not apply if:

* Your portfolio mainly contains long-form videos

* You rely heavily on CapCut templates

* Every video uses excessive emojis, sound effects and transitions

* You need detailed instructions for every cut

* You cannot explain why you made an editing decision

* You submit generic applications written by AI

* You are not bonus-driven to put the work in



If this sounds like you, send your up-to-date portfolio.



To confirm you've fully read this job post, include the word "black" at the end of your application.



Work is fully remote. We can also provide your equipment.

title: Video Editor
description:

We are looking for a talented and creative Video Editor to join our Media Division. Creative mindset with strong attention to detail.

Join our Media Division and help us create powerful visual experiences that connect with audiences and strengthen our brand presence.

title: Influencer & Partnership Development Specialist (Performance-Based, High-Quality Outreach)
description:
We are a licensed real estate company in Japan working with overseas investors.



This is NOT a VA or admin role.

This is a thinking role focused on outreach and partnerships.



Your job is to identify the RIGHT influencers, brokers, and professionals

and start meaningful conversations that can lead to real business partnerships.



If you rely on copy-paste templates or mass messaging, do NOT apply.



What You Will Do



• Research influencers, brokers, and professionals (US, Singapore, etc.)

• Understand their audience and positioning

• Write personalized outreach messages (Instagram / LinkedIn /
)

• Send only 1 thoughtful follow-up (no spam)

• Track replies and improve message quality



How Performance is Evaluated



We do NOT measure hours.



We evaluate based on:



• Reply rate

• Quality of replies (serious vs low-quality)

• Meaningful conversations started



Trial & Compensation



• 1–2 week paid trial

• Performance-based compensation (no hourly pay)

• Long-term opportunity for high performers



### Compensation Structure (Performance-Based)



This role is fully performance-based.



During both the trial and post-trial period, the same unit-based compensation applies:



• Valid collaboration reply: 500 JPY per reply (approx. 190 PHP)  

• Confirmed meeting booked: 3,000 JPY per meeting (approx. 1,140 PHP)  



 A reply only counts if it shows real interest in collaboration  

 Meeting payment applies only when a call is actually scheduled  



There is no fixed salary or hourly pay.



After the trial period:

• No monthly cap on earnings  

• Compensation increases based on output and quality  

• Additional incentives or bonuses may be added over time for strong performers  



Top performers can generate significant monthly income depending on performance.





 IMPORTANT – DO NOT APPLY IF



• You use copy-paste templates

• You send mass messages without thinking

• You cannot explain your strategy



 REQUIRED TO APPLY (MANDATORY)



To apply, you MUST complete the following task:



 Task: Write a REAL outreach message



Choose ONE of the following:



• A US-based real estate influencer

• A broker with international clients



Then submit:



 Cold DM

 A personalized outreach message (no templates)



 Follow-up message

 Only ONE follow-up



 Strategy explanation

 Why this message would get a reply

 What response you are trying to get



 Target link

 Instagram / LinkedIn / Website of the person you chose



 Applications will be rejected if:



• Messages look generic

• No personalization

• No explanation

• Target is not relevant



After the trial, compensation will be fully performance-based, 

linked to qualified conversations and partnership outcomes.
